acceptance_criteria.description: A done or cancelled review source snapshot whose current bytes drift is accepted only when the exact locator digest and size exist in reachable Git history
Review evidence for every non-terminal issue still requires the current path bytes to match exactly
Missing paths and fabricated digest or size values still fail closed
Required workflows fetch full Git history before lab doctor
Guidance prefers immutable artifacts and documents historical source snapshot recovery

objective: Keep completed or cancelled lab reviews recoverable when a repository-relative source file changes by accepting an exact historical Git blob match, while active work continues to fail closed.
title: Verify terminal review source snapshots through Git history
